sections.brief: The documented respects in which the taught promise holds: record median income and high OECD rank, low poverty among full-time workers, immigrants' children's mobility, Hispanic mobility and Black cohort gains, high-mobility places, the 1940 cohort and the GI Bill (with its Southern limits), cheaper food and goods, falling net tuition; and what this record does not show. Figures: time; compare (told vs record); stats

Primer: absolute vs relative mobility, income vs wealth, median vs mean, real vs nominal, which price index (with Winship's re-estimates and the volume's deflator rule), household vs individual, before vs after taxes and transfers. Figures: compare; stats; flow
